fields.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an item is in my cart, When I start checkout, Then 1 unit is reserved within 2 seconds.
Given a reservation is 15 minutes old, When payment has not completed, Then the unit is released.
Given the item is out of stock, When I start checkout, Then I see an out-of-stock message.
fields.technicalNotes: Checkout publishes a StockReserved event to Warehouse. Data owner: Warehouse.
